text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Bitter melon, celery, clams, garlic... Ah! 
Put that and this in there too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*Phaaar*~~! Now then, let's see what kind 
of effect this original health drink has!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*yaaawn*... It's so weird... I didn't 
recover from my fatigue at all this time 
either, ugh...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, which combination of ingredients 
could be the culprit? ...Tonight's the 
night I uncover its true identity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In her quest to find the cause, Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi ended up staying up even later 
into the night.
